The graph in black. Where each test fills a node, and where it breaks.
Giza bedrock — and the quarry too
NO STAKE — 21 nodes go dark here
blocks · flood window · ~20 yrs of state
IMPORT granite · BUILD harbour · WAIT flood
sound stone? does it fit? is it level?
rejected plans still visible in the fabric
masses encounter, they do not acquire
the block COUPLES to the structure
PARTLY NO — the HOW was lost
no-hair theorem — mass, spin, charge only
none of the four lanes fits
Sneferu → Khufu at the corrected angle
GRAVITY · no BOUNDARY · MATERIAL and ENERGY are one slot · the NO branch is unreachable · no stake, so 21 nodes go dark at once
PYRAMIDS · the REQUIREMENT is not its own, it is BORROWED from its maker · ACTION collapses to signalling, 7 of 8 empty
BOTH · ASSIMILATION and INTEGRATION are the same event · hunger-minted words fail: intake→COUPLING, cooking→CONDITIONING, harvest→ENCOUNTER, +PHYSICAL inheritance lane
